ranked_facts.concept_key: core temperature above 40°C with central nervous system dysfunction after exertion
ranked_facts.why: Exertional heat stroke is more likely to cause core temperature above 40°C with central nervous system dysfunction after exertion, whereas infectious processes and neurologic disorders are less likely to present with this specific combination of symptoms.

ranked_facts.concept_key: profuse sweating rather than dry skin
ranked_facts.why: Exertional heat stroke typically presents with profuse sweating, whereas toxic/metabolic disorders may present with dry skin, making this fact more supportive of exertional heat stroke.
